_about: A panel schedule's header facts onto its panel elements (Q6591): which header labels give which panel property and how its value reads. `labels` are whole words of the printed label, best first (the first label a header has wins). `read`: text (as printed), amps (its number, in A), volts / phase (that part of a volts/phase fact: `208Y/120V, 3PH, 4W` gives 208Y/120V and 3PH, 4W), word (one of `values`, each with the printed words that mean it; a word none lists is kept as printed). `prefix`: put before a bare printed value (`1` under NEMA RATING is NEMA 1). A typical schedule (TYPICAL OF n) is the schedule of every panel of its type: each takes its header.
typical_note: a typical schedule: the schedule of every panel of its type
